symbols.G: positive integer new MC02 seconds grant
symbols.N: positive integer new MC02 dispatch allowance
symbols.U: planning+overhead+all historical charges+all historical reserved+all historical external charges
symbols.C: ceil(max(0,M-U)), explicitly closure only, not paid cost
symbols.D: max(0,ceil(U+C)-M), explicitly reviewed integer closure reconciliation, not spendable grant

amendedTopLevel.externalPackageCharges: all old rows unchanged plus MC02 grant-specific exact debits
amendedTopLevel.reserved: all old rows unchanged plus historical closure C and active grant reserve G-S
amendedTopLevel.successorEnvelopes: all old entries retained/nonspendable; new immutable-grant-bound MC02 envelope remainingReservedSeconds=G-S,workerDispatches=n,workerDispatchLimit=N

activeOwnerSemantics.selectedPackageBudget: exact new MC02 grant envelope G; not lifetimeMC02 totals
activeOwnerSemantics.masterSlackAfter: M+D-U-C, nonnegative and <1 when ceiling conversion is sole D; cannot be spent outside new envelope
activeOwnerSemantics.prepaidEligibility: exact matching committed debit/action/candidate/runner and not-yet-claimed; all totals<=ceilings; n<=N; own full-bound chargedSeconds retained; allow n=N or G-S=0 for this one debit only
activeOwnerSemantics.newDebitEligibility: S+cost<=G and n+1<=N, plus aggregate limits and exclusive lock; no borrowed historic/master rounding surplus

unknowns: Unquantified closed historical allocations remain referenced unknown; they are not synthetic0 rows and confer no credit. Explicit reviewed disposition must establish they cannot debit the active grant retroactively. Otherwise reject.
consumerChange: For exact finalized-financial-settlement profile, validated accounting producer returns selected authenticated envelope ownership, limits and prepaid state; reader must not apply top-level MC01 package/worker limits to MC02. Legacy behavior remains separate.
